bare.docx.note: minimal.docx without the document.xml Override — G4 lenient open

blank_page.pdf.note: text page + blank verso + text page — the blank page routed `empty`, no ATR (D29)

bold_titles.pdf.note: bold section titles at the body size; bold lines that are not titles (#5)

enrichable.pdf.note: 1 page, diacritic-free Czech archaeology — the LLM stage's input

font_switch.pdf.note: Czech letters from a second font subset mid-word; a Ts superscript (#5)

garbled.pdf.note: WinAnsi declared over cp1250, no /ToUnicode — must trip decode-sanity

headings.pdf.note: title, paragraphs and a table of smaller type; an OCR page's ',' — headings (#5)

image_only.pdf.note: text page + image-only page + blank page — G1 needs_ocr; the blank page `blank` (D29)

minimal.docx.note: heading + 2 paragraphs + 2x2 table + explicit page break

minimal.pdf.note: 2 pages, 3 text blocks, no diacritics — happy path for bbox + group_id

ocr_layer.pdf.note: page image + invisible (3 Tr) text on both pages — G7 OCR layer

photo_text.docx.note: a long paragraph, a photo, a caption on one page — visual lines, no ATR for a photo (#9)

rich.docx.note: title/localized headings, ins/del, footnote, text box, header/footer, 4 pages

rotated.pdf.note: vertical table headers (ttb with a second subset, btt); a btt caption (#5)

sample.csv.note: a header row and rows with a text column among others — every column kept (#9)

sample.json.note: string values in objects and lists, with keys and numbers — every string kept (#9)

sample.tsv.note: the CSV's rows as tab-separated values (#9)

sample.txt.note: two paragraphs, a form feed, a second page — the textual workflow (#9)

sample.xlsx.note: find records: counts, decimals, an area, a share, two dates, a time, a boolean, a formula, a hidden sheet — every cell as displayed (#9)

scan_page.docx.note: text page, a page of one picture (a pasted scan), text page — only the picture page needs the ATR (#9)

small_caps.pdf.note: capitals then smaller capitals in one word; real spaces; a Ts capital (#5)

stamped_scan.pdf.note: page number over a full-page image → none; text page; half-page image (#5)

two_column.pdf.note: 2 pages, 2 columns, title, running header, page-number footer, roman labels

unmapped.pdf.note: codes StandardEncoding leaves undefined → (cid:N) → U+FFFD; both pages garbled: undecodable, lost letters (#5)
